title: Heaven and its Wonders and Hell
author: Emanuel Swedenborg
description: Emanuel Swedenborg describes heaven, hell and the spiritual world through the visionary account underlying his religious thought. The work connects the life of the soul with love, moral choice and an elaborate system of spiritual correspondences.
